name: testE11MedicationReference
title: E-11 Unit Test: MedicationRequest.medication Reference code extraction
description: E-11 unit test library (defect-tracking/engine-issues.md): reproduces the 'Unable to extract codes from fhirType Reference' runtime failure from a terminology-filtered retrieve over MedicationRequest.medication when the fixture uses medicationReference (no medicationCodeableConcept), and demonstrates the passing medicationCodeableConcept path. Same root cause as CMS135 and CMS165 (AdvancedIllnessandFrailty.cql:77).
